title: The OA normalization batch (census 939)

banner.title: The OA normalization batch - 47 defs rewritten to the full-field 57-key emission - the book closes complete
banner.provenance: The OA normalization - the per-book schema pass continued (the R879 normalizer doctrine, continuing R1009-R1014 the MM1 arc): every sparse OA def rewritten to the full-field 57-key emission of the landed tools/normalize_registry.py - string sentinels n/a, integer sentinels -1, saveAsBonus riding the loader zero default (the R155 contract) - byte-exact against the normalizer output, the canonical FIELD_ORDER honored. The OA defs were promoted to the registry post-normalizer, so this batch is ALL INSERT SITES - 332 anchored inserts (1276 inserted lines), zero whole-line reorders, zero move encodings; the fields are already in canonical order, only sparse. No normalizer repairs ride this round. The audited key in this batch - chiang_lung - rides a registry presence check only, no field constraints. The OA census after this round: 47 defs, 47 canonical, 0 remaining - THE BOOK CLOSES COMPLETE, the promotions (records, tables, monster defs) and the normalization both green. THE QUEUE: MM2 332, FF 185, WSG+MOP 23, DRG 5 follow.

audit_comment: THE OA NORMALIZATION - the per-book schema pass continued: 47 defs rewritten to the full-field 57-key emission, byte-exact against the landed normalize_registry.py; all insert sites, no reorder sites; the book closes complete.

include_after: #include "rules/oa/oa9.h"  // R1015: the OA table promotion batch nine
